answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method, FECS, on two tasks known for their susceptibility to hallucination issues: abstractive summarization and dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We employ the following metrics: Standard Metrics... ROUGE... BLEU-4... BERTScore... Faithfulness Metrics... FEQA... Q2... Diversity Metric... Rep-n.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation to assess the faithfulness of our proposed FECS on the abstractive summarization task... ask annotators to vote which response is considered more faithful to the provided source.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators vote which generated summary is more faithful to the source article.
